title: A quest packet: quest records with their blueprint (quests/80 §58, decision 0153; 2.11 b)
description: The one source of the quest blueprint. The Python validator (worldgen.quests) validates through it; packages/narrative/src/blueprint.ts mirrors it field for field and blueprint.schema.test.ts holds the two equal. Conditions and actions are the quests/85 vocabulary, checked by name and arguments in the validator and compiled by packages/dialogue at load.

condition.description: A quests/85 § A predicate call or an all/any/not composition (§ D); names and arguments are checked by the vocabulary.

action.description: A quests/85 § B action call: exactly one key, its argument or argument list.

where.description: Where an objective's person, thing or count stands in the facts record (2.11 § c).

ref.description: The facts socket, stand or landmark id of the thing to find.

area.description: The facts counts area a count objective is gathered in.

kind.description: The facts count the objective's number is held against.

direction.description: A direction walked on the shipped route graph (0137) from where it is given to inside the named place's facts extent.

from.description: Where it is given; defaults to the stage's place.

landmarks.description: Facts landmark ids it names; each in sight of the route.

claim.description: A cardinal or relative claim ("the cave east of town"), judged on facts positions.

subject.description: A place id or a facts landmark id.

of.description: The bearing is taken from this place's facts position; inside/outside its facts extent.

journal.description: The journal entry written on entering the stage.

successors.description: When every required objective is complete, the first successor whose when holds is entered.

failForward.description: Checked at any time on this stage: a met when moves the quest on (fail-forward, quests/80 §63); each needs a when.

ending.description: Entering this stage ends the quest so.

place.description: The place this stage enters (read by the § c stance rule).

entry.description: How a stage entering a hostile place is reached when no flip is met (2.11 § c).

directions.description: The directions the stage's journal or dialogue gives (2.11 § c).

outside.description: A partial quest stops here: the stage's place is past the slice and this Part 4 packet owns it (0153).

standInFor.description: 0157: the canon quest this record stands in for until that quest's anchor is built.

start.description: The first stage; defaults to the lowest stage id.

startWhen.description: Any quests/85 condition: an unstarted quest enters its start stage on the first world event after it holds (a quest begun by what the player finds, not by a giver).
